events.text: Cairns was paid off in Brisbane.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Cairns was paid off in Brisbane on 17 January 1946 .

events.text: She was recommissioned into the Royal Australian Navy (RNLN) and renamed HNLMS Ambon.
events.subject: self
events.quote: She was immediately recommissioned into the Royal Australian Navy ( RNLN ) and renamed HNLMS Ambon .
